t: A cheap Wi-Fi chip hiding inside many smart plugs, bulbs and switches.
steps: Find a smart plug or switch with a Tuya CB2S, CB3S or CBU module, or buy a bare module from LCSC.
Check the tuya-cloudcutter device list. Some devices can be flashed over the air with no soldering.
Get a 3.3 volt USB serial adapter with a strong power supply.
Solder wires to the TX1, RX1, 3.3 volt and ground pads on the module.
Install ltchiptool on your computer and save a backup of the factory firmware.
Flash the OpenBeken firmware with ltchiptool.
Join the new Wi-Fi hotspot and open its web page to set up your home network.
Add the device to Home Assistant and toggle the relay from your phone.
